meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 将 NanoClaw 某个 agent 组切到本地 Ollama 模型:该组请求改发本地 Ollama 而非 Anthropic API;只需改环境变量和模型名等配置,不改代码。可屏蔽 Anthropic API。
howto.when: 当用户想本地运行 agent、节省 API 费用,或尝试开源权重模型时触发;也可在需要把已有 agent 组切到 Ollama 时使用。

say.text: 帮我把 A 组切到本地 Ollama 模型
say.note: 会先确认要切换的组和模型

say.text: 把 B 组改用 qwen3-coder 模型,并屏蔽 Anthropic API
say.note: 会写入环境变量和模型名,并屏蔽 Anthropic

say.text: 帮我看看本机有哪些 Ollama 模型
say.note: 会列出本地已拉取的模型供选择

howto.what_en: Routes a specified NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. The group's requests go to local Ollama; only env var and model settings change, no code changes. Can optionally block the Anthropic API.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to run an agent locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models; also when switching an existing group to Ollama.

say_en.text: Switch group A to the local Ollama model.
say_en.note: It will ask which group and model first.

say_en.text: Use model qwen3-coder for group B and block the Anthropic API.
say_en.note: Writes env and model settings; blocks api.anthropic.com.

say_en.text: List the Ollama models available on this machine.
say_en.note: Shows pulled models to pick from.
